text:
ara: Quick ask — during a large onboarding run in us-west1 we saw KV cache evictions spike and tail latency climb. Looking for the canonical dashboard/panels to check SM% vs KV evictions and a quick way to snapshot for the incident ticket. Model was llama-13b-q4, batchsize=32. Any pointers on which panels and which trace/log queries to grab?

dom: Use the GPU overview -> "Serving Runtime -> GPU Utilization (per-pool)" dashboard in Grafana. Panel IDs I usually look at: SM% heatmap (panel 12), KV cache evictions (panel 18), per-request tail latency (panel 21). Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/serving/runtime-gpu?orgId=1&var-region=us-west1

kiran: If you want traces, filter by trace tag `model=llama-13b-q4` and `pool=dedicated-usw1`. In Tempo/Jaeger the query is basically:
```
service=runtime and tags.model=llama-13b-q4 and tags.pool=dedicated-usw1
```
That pulls the slow tails.

ara: Thanks — any quick log queries for evictions?

dom: For logs (Loki) use this Loki query to find eviction events around the run: 
```
{job="runtime",region="us-west1"} |= "kvcache_eviction" | json | line_format "ts={.ts} pool={.pool} key_count={.count} reason={.reason}"
```
That returns the eviction lines with counts.

opsbot: Monitor triggered: kvcache-evictions-high (alert_id: monitor-7321) — fired at 2026-07-20T15:12:04Z. Link: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/monitors/7321

kiran: If you're preparing an incident snapshot, grab a Grafana snapshot (Share -> Snapshot -> Save locally) and attach to the ticket. If you want a public snapshot instead of local, use the snapshot API: POST /api/snapshots with org API token. Otherwise download panel PNGs: Share -> Panel -> Export PNG.

maria: For the alert tuning: current monitor is threshold-based on `eviction_rate > 5% for 5m` which is noisy for onboarding runs. Suggest temp change to `eviction_rate > 10% for 15m` and add a suppression for label `job: onboarding`. I'll open a quick PR to change that with rollback in 24h. Who should I cc for approval?

ara: cc @kiran and @dom please. We want to avoid masking genuine production regressions — if evictions co-occur with SM%>90% and latency>500ms then escalate.

kiran: Agree. Proposed short circuit in monitor: only fire if `eviction_rate > X` AND (`sm_percent > 88` OR `p99_latency_ms > 500`). That reduces false positives during onboarding bursts.

maria: I'll draft the PR with the combined condition and include the Grafana snapshot link and Loki query. Plan: bump thresholds, add onboarding suppression tag, set auto-revert in 24h.

samuel: ack — thanks. If you need me to capture more traces I can run a quick trace sampler for the exact time window.

ara: Great. One last thing — is there a quick way to simulate the batchsize=32 workload on staging to validate the change?

dom: You can run the loadjob in infra/tools/loadgen: `./run_load_test --model llama-13b-q4 --batch 32 --region staging-usw1 --duration 5m` That reproduces kvcache pressure. Remember to set `TEST_RUN=true` env var to avoid metric tagging as production.

maria: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-monitoring/pulls/487 — includes snapshot and proposed threshold change. Tagging reviewers: @kiran @dom.

ara: Perfect — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
